layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Spinosaurus paddle-like tail morphology
features: A wide, flat, fin-like tail made of textured orange and green clay
Visible vertical clay ridges resembling neural spines within the tail fin
Soft, rounded edges to look safe and friendly for children
The tail is vertically oriented like a tadpole or newt tail
Subtle clay 'scale' textures and damp sheen
layer_3_action.action: A centered, cinematic macro shot focusing on the unique paddle shape of the tail. The background is a soft, out-of-focus neutral studio gradient to emphasize the morphology. No text.
